rationale.purpose: Keep underground bosses from blocking unrelated chunks/space above or below in Overworld/Nether and other dimensions.
rationale.decision_source: User explicitly reports Harbinger and other underground bosses and requests correction then local server startup; this changes the former full-height hosted-boss lock.
rationale.user_requested: Underground structures must not block upper chunks; apply common correction and start server afterward.
rationale.codex_choices: Use actual registered structure volume for all structural arenas, six collision faces, conditional Y-aware event queries and one-time legacy entry migration; preserve wall style.
